scope: Lysates were normalized to 3 mg/ml of protein before incubation with anti-FLAG-M2 affinity gel (Sigma) at 4°C for 18 h.
Following immunoprecipitation, the combined samples were subjected to SDS-PAGE electrophoresis on a precast gel, and extracted as a single band for in-gel trypsinisation.
